label: Commodity arrivals
description: Quantity of the commodity (dims commodity/variety/grade) arriving at the market that day, Agmarknet column "Arrivals" in "Metric Tonnes". Published 0 -> not_reported.

label: Market reported prices
description: One per market and day. reported: value = number of commodity/variety/grade price lines in that day's report. not_reported: the market filed a "NIL Transaction" entry; value_text gives Agmarknet's reason verbatim (e.g. "NIL Transaction - No Arrivals", "NIL Transaction - Weekend Holiday"). Days with nothing uploaded have no observation.

label: Maximum price
description: Highest price of the day for the commodity line, Agmarknet "Maximum Price" (Rs./Quintal). Published 0 -> not_reported.

label: Minimum price
description: Lowest price of the day for the commodity line, Agmarknet "Minimum Price" (Rs./Quintal). Published 0 -> not_reported.

label: Modal price
description: Price at which most of the commodity traded that day, Agmarknet "Modal Price" (Rs./Quintal). Published 0 -> not_reported.

label: NOx (SMC real-time sensor)
description: Latest NOx reading.

label: PM10 (SMC real-time sensor)
description: Latest PM10 reading.

label: PM2.5 (SMC real-time sensor)
description: Latest PM2.5 reading of the SMC sensor station, as shown on the Air Quality Results page.

label: Relative humidity (SMC sensor station)
description: Relative humidity at the sensor station at the time of the reading.

label: SO2 (SMC real-time sensor)
description: Latest SO2 reading.

label: Ambient temperature (SMC sensor station)
description: Ambient temperature at the sensor station at the time of the reading.

label: Capital expenditure (CityFinance)
description: "Total Capital Expenditure" from the CityFinance overview, which CityFinance derives from fixed assets and capital work in progress in the balance sheet. It is N/A (not_reported) for years with no audited year just before them. Published in crore to 2 decimals.

label: Revenue expenditure by account head (CityFinance income statement)
description: Income statement amount for one expenditure head (dims.head), e.g. establishment (code 210) or depreciation (272). Capital spending is not in the income statement.

label: Total expenditure in the income statement (CityFinance)
description: "Total Expenditure (B)" of the income statement: the sum of the expenditure heads. It excludes capital expenditure and prior-period items.

label: Income by account head (CityFinance income statement)
description: Income statement amount for one head (dims.head), e.g. tax_revenue (code 110) or fees_user_charges (140). Blank cells are not_reported; older years report fewer heads separately.

label: Total revenue (CityFinance)
description: "Total Income (A)" of the income statement: the sum of all income heads, including assigned revenues and revenue grants. CityFinance shows the same figure as "Total Revenue".

label: Own source revenue (CityFinance)
description: "Own Source Revenue" from the CityFinance overview: income statement codes 110, 130-150 and 170-180 (tax, rent, fees, sales and other income incl. interest), excluding assigned revenues and grants (checked for all 8 years). Published in crore to 2 decimals (Rs 1 lakh).

label: Revenue expenditure (CityFinance)
description: "Total Revenue Expenditure" from the CityFinance overview. In every year checked it equals the income statement total expenditure plus prior-period items. Published in crore to 2 decimals.

label: Cases disposed
description: Cases disposed of in the window dims.window, as shown on the Virtual Justice Clock on the clock date.

label: Cases instituted
description: Cases instituted (filed) in the window dims.window, as shown on the Virtual Justice Clock on the clock date (period). Windows: today, last_day, last_week, last_month, this_year, last_year.

label: Case clearance rate
description: Case clearance rate (disposed / instituted, whole percent as published) in the window dims.window. not_reported where the page shows "--".

label: Air Quality Index (CPCB daily bulletin)
description: City AQI in the CPCB 4 PM bulletin: average over the city's stations of the past 24 hours. not_reported (value_text = reason) when the bulletin lists the city as absent for insufficient data.

label: AQI category (CPCB daily bulletin)
description: value_text = "Air Quality" column: Good, Satisfactory, Moderate, Poor, Very Poor or Severe.

label: Prominent pollutant(s) (CPCB daily bulletin)
description: value_text = "Prominent Pollutant" column as printed, e.g. "PM10, PM2.5".

label: Stations in the city AQI
description: Number of monitoring stations that contributed to the city AQI that day ("Participated").

label: Stations in the city
description: Number of CPCB-listed monitoring stations for the city ("Total Stations").

label: Station AQI (CPCB CAAQMS feed)
description: airQualityIndexValue of the station in the CPCB feed at lastUpdate.

label: Station prominent pollutant (CPCB CAAQMS feed)
description: value_text = predominantParameter of the station in the CPCB feed.

label: Pollutant sub-index, average (CPCB CAAQMS feed)
description: The pollutant's "avg" value in the CPCB feed (dims.pollutant = the feed's indexId: PM2.5, PM10, NO2, NH3, SO2, CO, OZONE). It is on the AQI scale (the station AQI is the highest of them), not a concentration.

label: Electric buses operated
description: "Total No. of Electric Buses Operated" on the page, as of its last-updated date.

label: Fuel saved per day by electric buses
description: "Fuel saving per day (In Litres)" as published (SMC does not say how the daily figure is derived).

label: Fuel saved by electric buses (cumulative)
description: "Total saved fuel (In Litres)": running total since e-bus operations began, as estimated by SMC.

label: GHG emissions avoided per day
description: "GHG emission reduction (CO2e per day in Kg.)" as published.

label: GHG emissions avoided (cumulative)
description: "Total GHG emission reduction (CO2e in Kg.)": running total since e-bus operations began.

label: Electric bus kilometres run (cumulative)
description: "Total Run Km": running total since e-bus operations began (start date not published).

label: Council seats by reservation category
description: Seats allotted in the ward for the general election that used the electoral roll of the period date, by dims.category (general, sc, st, obc) and dims.women_reserved (yes = seat reserved for women, no = open seat). Counted from the per-seat allotment columns; all four seats of every ward are listed, so a 0 is a published fact, not a gap.

label: Registered voters
description: Total voters on the electoral roll as on the period date. smc_city is the published total row.

label: Registered voters by gender
description: Voters on the electoral roll as on the period date, by dims.gender (male, female, third_gender).

label: Ward population (Census 2011, election-ward limits)
description: Population as per Census 2011 re-aggregated to the election-ward limits after the 2020 city-limit extension, as used for seat allotment. smc_city is the published total row.

label: Retail price of essential commodities (DoCA, Surat centre)
description: Daily retail price reported by the Surat centre to DoCA, by commodity (dims.commodity). DoCA gives retail prices in Rs/kg. Milk is marked "@" by DoCA, and its unit (probably per litre) was not confirmed on the pages checked.

label: Wholesale price of essential commodities (DoCA, Surat centre)
description: Daily wholesale price reported by the Surat centre to DoCA, by commodity (dims.commodity). DoCA gives wholesale prices in Rs/quintal (100 kg). Milk is marked "@" and its basis was not confirmed.

label: Fixed assets: accumulated depreciation
description: "Less: Depreciation" under Fixed Assets. As at 31 March.

label: Cash and bank balances
description: Current assets (c) "Cash and bank balances". As at 31 March.

label: Current assets, loans and advances (total)
description: Unlabelled subtotal of the "Current assets, loans and advances" block. As at 31 March.

label: Current liabilities
description: Less: Current liabilities and Provisions, (a) "Current liabilities". As at 31 March.

label: Capital work in progress
description: "Capital - Work In Progress (FA)". As at 31 March.

label: Fixed assets: gross block
description: "Gross Block" of fixed assets. As at 31 March.

label: Inventories
description: Current assets (a) "Inventories". As at 31 March.

label: Investments
description: "Investments". As at 31 March.

label: Loan funds (total)
description: Unlabelled subtotal of the "Loan Funds" block (secured + unsecured loans). Some years (FY2015-16 to FY2017-18) print no Loan Funds block at all. As at 31 March.

label: Loans and advances
description: Current assets (d) "Loans and advances". As at 31 March.

label: Municipal fund
description: Own funds (a) "Municipal Funds" (schedule 1). As at 31 March.

label: Fixed assets: net block
description: "Net Block" = gross block - accumulated depreciation. As at 31 March.

label: Own funds (total)
description: Unlabelled subtotal of the "Own Funds" block (municipal fund + reserves and surplus). As at 31 March.

label: Provisions for taxes
description: Less: Current liabilities and Provisions, (b) "Provisions For Taxes". As at 31 March.

label: Reserves and surplus
description: Own funds (b) "Reserves and surplus" (schedule 2). As at 31 March.

label: Secured loans
description: "Secured loans" under Loan Funds. As at 31 March.

label: Sundry debtors
description: Current assets (b) "Sundry Debtors": amounts receivable. As at 31 March.

label: Balance sheet total
description: "GRAND TOTAL" of the balance sheet (sources of funds = application of funds; the parser checks that both sides print the same figure). As at 31 March.

label: Unsecured loans
description: "Unsecured Loans" under Loan Funds (printed from FY2023-24). As at 31 March.

label: Budget summary: expenditure (revenue/capital)
description: Revenue or capital expenditure of the zone (dims.account), as budgeted or as spent. dims.account: revenue | capital. dims.measure: budget_original ("Original"), budget_revised ("Revised"), actual ("Actuals"), actual_tentative ("Actuals (Tent.)" of a past year) or actual_ytd ("Actuals (Tent.)" of the current budget year, cumulative from 1 April to period_end = the page's weekly "Last on" date). Published in Rs '000; stored in rupees.

label: Budget summary: income (revenue/capital)
description: Revenue or capital income of the zone (dims.account), as budgeted or as received. dims.account: revenue | capital. dims.measure: budget_original ("Original"), budget_revised ("Revised"), actual ("Actuals"), actual_tentative ("Actuals (Tent.)" of a past year) or actual_ytd ("Actuals (Tent.)" of the current budget year, cumulative from 1 April to period_end = the page's weekly "Last on" date). Published in Rs '000; stored in rupees.

label: Administration expenses
description: Expenditure: "Administration Expenses". For the financial year April-March.

label: Depreciation
description: Expenditure: "Depreciation" charged for the year. For the financial year April-March.

label: Payments and benefits to employees
description: Expenditure: "Payments & Benefits to Employees". For the financial year April-March.

label: Excess of income over expenditure
description: "Excess of Income Over Expenditure" = surplus after tax + prior period income - prior period expenses; negative = excess of expenditure. For the financial year April-March.

label: Finance charges
description: Expenditure: "Finance Charges" (interest etc.). For the financial year April-March.

label: Government grants, contributions and subsidies
description: Income: "Govt. Grants, Contri. & Subsidies" credited to income. For the financial year April-March.

label: Loss on sale/disposal of fixed assets
description: Expenditure: "Loss on Sale/Disposal of Fixed Asset". For the financial year April-March.

label: Non-tax revenues
description: Income: "Non Tax Revenues" (fees, user charges, etc.). For the financial year April-March.

label: Compensation in lieu of octroi
description: Income: "Compensation in lieu of Octroi" from the State. For the financial year April-March.

label: Other expenses
description: Expenditure: "Other Expenses". For the financial year April-March.

label: Other income
description: Income: "Other Income". For the financial year April-March.

label: Prior period expenses
description: Prior period adjustments (b) "Prior period Expenses". For the financial year April-March.

label: Prior period income
description: Prior period adjustments (a) "Prior period incomes". For the financial year April-March.

label: Repairs and maintenance
description: Expenditure: "Repairs and Maintenance". For the financial year April-March.

label: Service and utilities charges
description: Expenditure: "Service & Utilities Charges". For the financial year April-March.

label: Net surplus (deficit) after taxation
description: "Net Surplus for the year after taxation"; negative = deficit. For the financial year April-March.

label: Net surplus (deficit) before taxation
description: "Net Surplus for the year before taxation" = total income - total expenditure; negative = deficit. For the financial year April-March.

label: Provision for taxes
description: "Less : Provision for taxes" deducted from the surplus. For the financial year April-March.

label: Tax revenues
description: Income: "Tax Revenues" (e.g. property tax). For the financial year April-March.

label: Total expenditure
description: Unlabelled subtotal of the Expenditure block. For the financial year April-March.

label: Total income
description: Unlabelled subtotal of the Income block. For the financial year April-March.

label: Causeway overflow level (as published)
description: The "Causeway overflow at N mt." figure under the weir table: the level at which water overtops the causeway. Dated to the day of the latest weir reading it was shown with.

label: Causeway status (as published)
description: Text after "Causeway is" under the weir table (e.g. OPEN), stored in value_text. Stored at the instant of the latest weir reading shown with it; the page gives no separate time.

label: Creek (khadi) danger level (as published)
description: Danger level "D.L." printed in the creek column header, e.g. "(D.L.- 8.48 MT)". Dated to the day of the latest creek reading it was shown with.

label: Creek (khadi) water level
description: Water level at an SMC creek (khadi) gauge, Khadi Water Level tab (hourly readings), metres as published ("MT").

label: Ukai full reservoir level (as published)
description: The "Ukai Full Reservoir Level - N ft" figure printed above the Ukai table. Dated to the day of the latest Ukai reading it was shown with.

label: Ukai estimated inflow
description: Column "Est. Inflow (cusec)" of the Ukai Dam tab: estimated inflow into the reservoir at the reading time, cubic feet per second, as published. Observed pattern (27/09 and 03-04/10/2026): it equals the outflow in slots where the level is unchanged and reads 0.00 in every slot where the level fell, so it looks like a storage-balance estimate floored at zero; a 0 here is not a measured zero river flow.

label: Ukai reservoir level
description: Water level of the Ukai reservoir in feet, column "Level (ft)" of the Ukai Dam tab (2-hourly readings). The page states the Full Reservoir Level is 345 ft.

label: Ukai estimated outflow
description: Column "Est. Outflow (cusec)" of the Ukai Dam tab: estimated release from the dam at the reading time, cubic feet per second, as published.

label: Weir-cum-causeway water level
description: Column "Level (mt)" of the Weir-Cum-Causeway tab: water level at the Tapi weir-cum-causeway in Surat, metres as published (the page does not state the datum).

label: Weir-cum-causeway estimated outflow
description: Column "Est. Outflow (cusec)" of the Weir-Cum-Causeway tab, cubic feet per second.

label: Board-exam candidates appeared
description: Regular candidates who appeared (dims.exam).

label: Board-exam candidates by grade
description: District candidates by grade as printed (dims.grade). SSC: A1..D and E1* (differently-abled, passed with the 20% concession) are passes, E1 and E2 are not. HSC: A1..E1 add up to E.Q.C.

label: Board-exam pass percentage
description: GSEB result percentage: passed (E.Q.C.) / appeared x 100, as printed (dims.exam).

label: Board-exam candidates passed
description: Regular candidates eligible for the certificate (GSEB "E.Q.C."), i.e. passed (dims.exam).

label: Board-exam candidates registered
description: Regular candidates registered for the main examination (dims.exam).

label: Disease cases (incidence)
description: Monthly cases by disease (dims.disease). For gastroenteritis, enteric fever, pulmonary TB, pneumonia, hepatitis and cholera this is the "Ind" (incidence) row: admitted new cases reported at eight Surat hospitals. For malaria it is "Positive Cases - Nos." from the blood-smear surveillance table.

label: Disease deaths
description: Monthly deaths by disease (dims.disease): the "D" row of each disease table, or the "Death" column of the malaria table.

label: Malaria positive cases by parasite species
description: Positive cases by species (dims.species: p_vivax, p_falciparum); columns "P. Vivex(+) Case - Nos." and "P. Falci.(+) Cases - Nos.". On the snapshot they add up to the total positive cases.

label: Malaria blood smears collected
description: Malaria surveillance table, column "Collection": blood samples collected in the month.

label: Malaria blood smears examined
description: Malaria surveillance table, column "Examined": samples examined in the month.

label: Out-of-pocket cost per delivery in a public facility
description: Average out-of-pocket expenditure per delivery in a public health facility (NFHS fact sheet).

label: NFHS indicator (percentage)
description: NFHS district fact-sheet indicator expressed as a percentage; dims.indicator is the fact-sheet label, dims.factsheet_no its NFHS-5 row number. Period = survey round.

label: NFHS sex ratio
description: Sex ratio of the total population, or at birth for children born in the last five years (dims.indicator).

label: Flats in PMAY housing projects
description: Sum of "No. of Flats" over the listed projects, by dims.status. not_reported if any project in that group has a blank flat count.

label: PMAY housing projects
description: Number of SMC PMAY (affordable housing) projects listed on the page, by dims.status (completed / work_in_progress). Counted from the project rows.

label: Total rainfall, Surat city (cumulative)
description: Column "Total Rainfall (mm)" of the Total Rain Fall tab: cumulative rainfall for Surat city up to the reading time. The page does not state the start of the accumulation period (the monsoon season) or whether it is one gauge or an average of zones.

label: Zone-wise rainfall
description: Rainfall in the SMC zone for the slot ending at the reading time, from the Zonewise Rain Fall tab (2-hourly timestamps). Not cumulative over the season (all zones read 0.00 on 27/09/2026 while the season total was 1983 mm). The page does not say whether each figure is the rain of the preceding 2-hour slot or a running total for the day.

label: Appellate Authorities designated
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Number of first Appellate Authorities (AAs) designated, as filed for the year.

label: RTI additional fees and other charges collected
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. "Additional Fee & Any other charges" (copying charges etc.) collected during the year, in rupees.

label: Assistant PIOs designated
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Number of Assistant Public Information Officers (APIOs) designated, as filed for the year.

label: Disciplinary actions against officers under RTI
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Cases during the year where disciplinary action was taken against any officer.

label: RTI first appeals accepted
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Decisions during the year where first appeals were accepted, including partially rejected cases.

label: RTI first appeals pending at start of year
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. First appeals (to SMC's own appellate authorities) pending at the start of the year.

label: RTI first appeals received
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. First appeals received during the year.

label: RTI first appeals rejected
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Decisions during the year where first appeals were rejected.

label: RTI penalties collected
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Penalties amount "Collected" during the year, in rupees.

label: RTI penalties levied
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Penalties amount "Levied" during the year, in rupees.

label: RTI penalties total (as printed)
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. The penalties "Total" field printed after Levied and Collected, in rupees, stored as printed (the form does not say how it is computed).

label: Public Information Officers designated
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Number of Public Information Officers (PIOs) designated, as filed for the year.

label: RTI registration (application) fees collected
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. "Registration Fee Amount" collected during the year, in rupees.

label: RTI exemptions invoked when rejecting requests
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Number of times each provision of the RTI Act was invoked while rejecting requests during the year (dims.section: 8(1)(a)..8(1)(j), 9, 11, 24, other). One rejection can invoke several, so the sum can exceed rti.annual.requests_rejected.

label: RTI requests accepted
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Decisions during the year where requests were accepted, including partially rejected cases.

label: RTI requests pending at start of year
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Requests pending at the start of the year ("Opening Balance as on April 1st").

label: RTI requests received
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Requests received during the year, including cases then transferred to another public authority ("Received during the Period (including cases transferred to other Public Authority)").

label: RTI requests rejected
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Decisions during the year where requests were rejected.

label: RTI requests transferred to other authorities
description: Annual return (Gujarat State RTI Annual Return form), SMC as a whole. Requests transferred to another public authority during the year ("No. of cases transferred").

label: Appellate authorities (Patrak-8 header)
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Total number of appellate officers printed in the return header for the quarter.

label: RTI application fees received in quarter
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 13(a): application fees received during the quarter (cash or other forms), excluding applications received on transfer from other authorities, in rupees. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI exemptions upheld in first appeals (quarter)
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Rows 9(a)-(n): number of the appeals in rows 5 and 6 where the information asked for was refused, by section of the Act (dims.section: 8(1)(a)..8(1)(j), 9, 11, 24, other). The printed label of row (h) repeats clause (g) (a typo on the form); it is stored by position as 8(1)(h). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI exemptions upheld in first appeals, total
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Row 10: total of rows 9(a) to 9(n). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI first appeals allowed in full
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Row 4: appeals fully allowed (અપીલ સંપૂર્ણ મંજૂર). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI first appeals disposed of in quarter
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Row 7: total appeals disposed of during the quarter (rows 4 + 5 + 6). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI first appeals disposed of within time limit
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Row 7(a): of the appeals disposed of (row 7), those disposed of within the time limit of section 19(6). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI first appeals partly allowed
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Row 5: appeals partly allowed and partly rejected. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI first appeals pending at end of quarter
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Row 8: appeals pending at the end of the quarter (row 3 - row 7). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI first appeals pending at start of quarter
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Row 1: first appeals pending from earlier, at the start of the quarter. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI first appeals received in quarter
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Row 2: first appeals received during the quarter. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI first appeals rejected in full
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Row 6: appeals fully rejected (અપીલ સંપૂર્ણ નામંજૂર). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI first appeals on hand in quarter
description: Patrak-8 quarterly return (first appeals to appellate authorities), SMC as a whole. Row 3: total appeals (row 1 + row 2). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI income earlier in the financial year
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 13(d): total income in the earlier part of the current financial year, in rupees. The observation period is that part (1 April to the day before the quarter); not emitted for Q1. Stored as printed: in Q4 FY2025-26 the non_bpl (193828) and all (363873) columns disagree. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI income in financial year to date
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 14: total income from 1 April to the end of the quarter (13c + 13d), in rupees; the observation period is that span. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI fee and charges income in quarter
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 13(c): total income during the quarter (13a + 13b), in rupees. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI charges other than application fee (quarter)
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 13(b): charges other than the application fee (copying charges etc.) received during the quarter, in rupees. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: Public Information Officers (Patrak-7 header)
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Total number of Public Information Officers printed in the return header for the quarter.

label: RTI exemptions invoked in refusals (quarter)
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Rows 11(a)-(n): number of the refusals in rows 7 and 8 made under each section of the Act (dims.section: 8(1)(a)..8(1)(j), 9, 11, 24, other). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI refusals by section, total (quarter)
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 12: total of rows 11(a) to 11(n). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI applications disposed of in quarter
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 9: total applications disposed of during the quarter (rows 4 + 6 + 7 + 8). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI applications disposed of within time limit
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 9(a): of the applications disposed of (row 9), those disposed of within the statutory time limit. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI applications answered in full
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 6: applications where the information was supplied in full. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI applications pending at end of quarter
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 10: applications pending at the end of the quarter (row 3 - row 9). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI applications pending at start of quarter
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 1: applications pending from earlier, at the start of the quarter. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI applications received in quarter
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 2: applications received during the quarter. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI applications refused in full
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 7: applications where the information was refused in full. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI applications refused in part
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 8: applications where the information was partly refused. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI applications on hand in quarter
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 3: total applications (row 1 + row 2). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI applications partly transferred
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 5: applications partly transferred to another public authority during the quarter (not counted in row 9). Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: RTI applications wholly transferred
description: Patrak-7 quarterly return (applications to PIOs), SMC as a whole. Row 4: applications wholly transferred to another public authority during the quarter. Split by applicant category in dims.applicants: bpl (Below Poverty Line applicants), non_bpl (the "other" column) and all (the printed total column).

label: Blood bank: units issued, by component
description: Units issued in the month by component (dims.component), as listed under the page's "Smimer Hospital" sub-heading. The page is not consistent about whether these rows also cover units issued to other hospitals (its Grand Total sometimes adds the Other Hospital row, sometimes not), so do not add smimer.blood_units_issued_other_hospitals to them blindly.

label: Blood bank: blood donation camps held
description: Number of blood donation camps in the month.

label: Blood bank: units collected, by type of donation
description: Blood units collected in the month; dims.donation = voluntary_camp, voluntary_blood_bank or replacement. These add up to smimer.blood_units_collected_total.

label: Blood bank: units collected (grand total)
description: Grand total of blood units collected in the month, as published.

label: Blood bank: units issued to other hospitals
description: Row "Other Hospital" under "No. of Blood Units Issued".

label: Eye bank: eyes collected
description: Number of eyes collected by the eye bank in the month.

label: Eye bank: eyes utilised, by use
description: Eyes utilised in the month, dims.use = keratoplasty, sent_to_other_eye_bank or paediatric (row labels as published under "No. of Eyes Utilised").

label: ICU beds
description: Beds per intensive care unit (dims.unit) as stated in the table for that year.

label: ICU patients (monthly figure per ICU)
description: Monthly figure per intensive care unit (dims.unit). The page does not say whether these are admissions or patient-days; its own occupancy row (figure / days / beds) treats them as patient-days.

label: Human milk bank: milk collected
description: Amount of milk collected by the SMIMER human milk bank in the month.

label: Human milk bank: donor mothers
description: Number of donor mothers in the month.

label: Human milk bank: milk given to newborns
description: Amount of milk donated to newborns in the month.

label: Human milk bank: newborns receiving milk
description: Number of newborns who received milk in the month.

label: Average municipal solid waste collected
description: Average MSW collected per day in the month, by collection method (dims.mode).

label: Smart underground dustbins installed
description: Smart underground dustbins installed (mode smart_underground_dustbins only).

label: Night scraping/brushing routes
description: Total routes covered by night scraping/brushing (mode night_scraping only).

label: Collection trips
description: Total trips reported for the month, by collection method (dims.mode).

label: Vehicles used for collection
description: Number of vehicles utilised in the month, by collection method (dims.mode).

label: Dropout rate
description: Dropout rate at the preparatory / middle / secondary stage (dims.stage). API fields dpt/dmt/dst are not labelled on the UDISE+ dashboard; read as dropout rates by analogy with the UDISE+ reports.

label: Enrolment, foundational to secondary
description: Total enrolment from the foundational to the secondary stage (tenrF2Sec).

label: Enrolment by school category
description: Enrolment in schools of each UDISE+ school category (dims.category). As returned these do not add up to udise.enrolment (2024-25: 1,161,656 vs 1,286,170).

label: Enrolment by school management
description: Enrolment by school management (dims.management, same codes as udise.schools.by_management; "govt" is a subtotal).

label: Enrolment by social group
description: SC, ST, OBC and minority students, foundational to secondary (dims.group). Overlapping groups, not a partition of the total.

label: Enrolment by NEP stage
description: Enrolment in the foundational / preparatory / middle / secondary stage (dims.stage); the four add up to udise.enrolment.

label: Children with special needs enrolled
description: Number of CWSN students, foundational to secondary.

label: Gross enrolment ratio
description: Gross enrolment ratio at the foundational / preparatory / middle stage (dims.stage). Returned as null for districts so far (stored as not_reported).

label: PGI-D grade
description: PGI-D grade as text in value_text (e.g. PRACHESTA-1 = 51-60% of the maximum score).

label: PGI-D overall score
description: Performance Grading Index for Districts overall score returned for this UDISE+ year (2025-26 matches the PGI-D 2025-26 report).

label: Pupil-teacher ratio
description: Pupil-teacher ratio at the foundational / preparatory / middle / secondary level (dims.stage).

label: Schools
description: Total number of schools (totSch).

label: Schools by school category
description: Schools by UDISE+ school category, i.e. the classes offered (dims.category, e.g. upper_primary_1_8 = classes 1-8). Categories add up to all schools.

label: Schools by management
description: Schools by management (dims.management). "govt" is the subtotal of kendriya_vidyalaya, navodaya_vidyalaya, other_central_govt and state_govt; govt + govt_aided + private_unaided + other = all schools.

label: Govt and aided primary schools with Balvatika
description: Number of government and government-aided primary schools having Balvatika / pre-primary sections.

label: Government / aided schools having primary levels
description: Number of government (dims.management=govt) or government-aided schools having primary levels.

label: Schools with a facility
description: Percentage of schools having a facility (dims.facility); dims.condition is "available" or "functional" (e.g. electricity connection vs functional electricity connection).

label: Teachers
description: Total number of teachers (ttch).

label: Teachers by school management
description: Teachers by school management (dims.management; "govt" is a subtotal).

label: Transition rate
description: Transition rate between NEP stages (dims.transition, e.g. middle_to_secondary).

label: Administrative charges levied for breeding sites
description: Column "Adm. Charge": administrative charges collected from defaulters. The column does not state a unit; the VBDC home page describes them as charges collected, so read as rupees.

label: Biological control actions
description: Column "Biological control" (e.g. larvivorous fish release); the page does not state the unit.

label: Potential mosquito breeding spots checked
description: Column "Breedingspot" / "Breeding spot" of the intra- or peri-domestic survey (dims.survey). Read as spots checked: positives by mosquito type are reported separately and are a small fraction of it.

label: Breeding spots found positive, by mosquito type
description: Positive breeding spots by survey (dims.survey: intra_domestic, peri_domestic) and mosquito type (dims.mosquito: anopheles, aedes, culex, mixed). The published "Total" column is their sum.

label: Construction sites checked (peri-domestic survey)
description: VBDC peri-domestic survey: "Checked Construction" in the month.

label: Fogging machine rounds
description: Column "Fogging Machine Utilised (Round)", by equipment (dims.equipment: vehicle_mounted for "Geep mounted", handheld for "Handy Sets").

label: Houses checked (intra-domestic survey)
description: VBDC intra-domestic survey: "No. of Houses checked" in the month (repeat visits count again).

label: Notices issued for breeding sites
description: Column "Notice": notices issued to owners of premises with mosquito breeding.

label: Source reduction actions
description: Column "Source Reduction" (breeding sources removed/eliminated); the page does not state the unit.

label: Water samples collected at consumer taps
description: Water samples collected from household taps during supply in the month (SMC monthly PDF).

label: Water samples found fit
description: Samples found fit for drinking (SMC tests against IS:10500).

label: Water samples found unfit
description: Samples found unfit for drinking.

label: Reservoir warning level
description: value_text = the report's "Type of Warning": HIGH ALERT (above 90% full), ALERT (80-90%), WARNING (70-80%) or NIL (below 70%), per the report's own abstract.

label: Full reservoir level
description: Full reservoir level (FRL, metres) as printed in that day's report.

label: Reservoir water level
description: Present water level (PWL, metres) from the detailed dam statement; for Sardar Sarovar the "Present Water Level (in m)" of its page-1 block.

label: Design gross storage
description: Design gross storage capacity in million cubic metres. For a district or the state: the districtwise table's total over its dams.

label: Design live storage
description: Design live storage capacity (MCM). District/state values from the districtwise table.

label: Present gross storage
description: Present gross storage (MCM) on the report date. District/state values from the districtwise table.

label: Storage, % of design gross
description: Present gross storage as a percentage of design gross storage, as printed ("Percentage Filling %" for a dam; the gross % column of the districtwise table).

label: Inflow
description: Inflow into the reservoir in cusecs as printed in the report (Sardar Sarovar: the "Inflow in Cusecs" of the major-schemes table).

label: Present live storage
description: Present live storage (MCM) on the report date. District/state values from the districtwise table.

label: Live storage, % of design live
description: Present live storage as a percentage of design live storage, from the districtwise table (districts, the state total and Sardar Sarovar only; the dam statement does not print it).

label: Outflow to canals
description: Outflow released to canals, cusecs, as printed.

label: Outflow to the river
description: Outflow released to the river, cusecs, as printed.

label: Rainfall at the dam, last 24 hours
description: Column RF of the dam statement (the rainfall statement calls it "Rain During Last 24 Hour").

label: Cumulative rainfall at the dam
description: Column CRF of the dam statement ("Cumm Rainfall"). The report does not state the start date of the accumulation.
